title: Erratum 01: the DOI link for Newcombe (1998) in the pre-registration does not resolve

parent.published: The pre-registration stays byte-identical and served. This note names it by sha256 and corrects one citation link beside it.

scope: This erratum corrects one citation link only; it changes no method, analysis, data, decision or result.

evidence.wasHandle: The doi.org handle API returns responseCode 100 (handle not found) for 10.1002/(SICI)1097-0258(19981030)17:20<2635::AID-SIM954>3.0.CO;2-C.
evidence.nowHandle: The doi.org handle API returns responseCode 1 for 10.1002/(SICI)1097-0258(19981130)17:22<2635::AID-SIM954>3.0.CO;2-C, with a URL value on onlinelibrary.wiley.com.

crossref.title: Improved confidence intervals for the difference between binomial proportions based on paired data

evidence.difference: The two DOIs differ only in the issue part: (19981030)17:20 in the record, (19981130)17:22 in Crossref. The record's label, Statistics in Medicine 17 (1998), is correct and stays.

statement: the DOI link in the frozen record does not resolve; the correct link is {now}. The record is unchanged.
